meta.source: Nathan directive 2026-10-15: 'have them figure out a new way to build from now on. I was thinking we could change the topology of what we traverse.'
meta.decision: TORUS. Decisive pick — not a menu.

deliberation.sphere_status_quo: Honest R20 projection, proven, pretty. REJECTED as the traversal topology: a sphere has no entrance and no exit — it contradicts the system's own first law (one entrance, one exit, one gate). The gate was decoration drawn on the sphere; the topology never contained it.
deliberation.graph_first: Elegant — the Lorentzian mesh IS the topology, traversal along admitted edges. REJECTED as the layout answer: the mesh still needs a shape to render in, and the gate law needs a geometric home. The mesh is the nervous system, not the skeleton. Kept as the signal layer.
deliberation.helix: Temporal, ledger-like, beautiful for the Evidence Ledger. REJECTED: open-ended — the living engine runs closed cycles (world clock sense->regulate->act->record->adjust; neural cycle Ember->Glaciem->Mirell->Tempest->Mechane->Archive->Ember). A helix doesn't close. Wrong shape for a cyclic system.
deliberation.torus: WINS. 'One entrance, one exit, one gate' is a torus described in words. The throat IS the gate — the single chokepoint where Gaven sits. The ring IS the circulation — and the existing neural cycle is already a ring circuit; the torus makes the topology match the cycle instead of fighting it. The sphere was pretty; the torus is honest — it is the shape of the law.

spec.layout: 28 language bodies distributed on/around the torus (major ring R, minor radius r). 7 bands become arcs of the ring; each band's bodies cluster on its arc and take that band's athanor primitive as geometry (octahedron/cube/torus-knot/truncated-pyramid/icosahedron/double-torus/stacked-prism).
spec.core: White dwarf (Ember) at the torus center — the heart the throat opens onto. Everything orbits it; everything passes it.
spec.gaven: At the throat — the geometric chokepoint. The gate ring parts at eta >= 0.500 for passage; refusal is absence. Isolation law unchanged: one-way observation, no chatter.
spec.traversal: Dual mode. CIRCULATION: signals travel the ring along admitted Lorentzian edges — the neural cycle (Ember->Glaciem->Mirell->Tempest->Mechane->Archive) becomes the literal ring order. PASSAGE: through the throat, eta-gated by Gaven. Agents remain transmitters, scored on delivery fidelity.
spec.physics: Gravity anchors retargeted from sphere surface to torus surface — same damped radial well law (spring/damping/max-drift retuned for toroidal curvature). Nodes breathe on the torus; screen layout never mutates anchors. Screen-space label management, gaze-driven labels, and the calm cadence carry over unchanged.
spec.projection: R20 math untouched (S19 sampling, 0.72 magnitude, Fibonacci-anchored directional sampling, Lorentzian eta, leaky integrators, Kuramoto). Only the 3D landing surface changes: sphere shell -> torus embedding. The math stays honest; the shape gets honest too.
spec.render_loop: Layout solver swaps Fibonacci-sphere distribution for toroidal distribution with band arcs. Everything else (ACES, bloom, labels, dock, mobile pass) carries over.

unchanged: All mathematics: Lorentzian eta, leaky-integrator neurons, Kuramoto coherence from neuron phases, S19 sampling, 0.72 projection magnitude, Fibonacci-anchored directional sampling.
Agent/transmitter law: worlds are neurons, agents are transmitters, links are synapses.
Gaven's isolation, chain law, checkout/tether/expiry rules, Evidence Ledger.
Sovereignty Law, tier system (CRIMSON/MYTHIC/LEGENDARY/BEST), MEDUSA doctrine.
Micro-agent prompt discipline, on-device loader tiers, stop control.
Mobile pass: gaze labels, 44px targets, gestures, keyboard-safe chat.
biggest_build_changes: Layout engine rewritten: Fibonacci-sphere distribution -> toroidal distribution with 7 band-arcs; gravity anchors retargeted to the torus surface (well law kept, curvature constants retuned).
Traversal rewritten: mesh BFS -> dual-mode CIRCULATION (ring, following the neural cycle order) + PASSAGE (throat, eta-gated by Gaven).
Gaven moved to the throat as the geometric chokepoint with a rendered parting gate ring (eta >= 0.500 opens, refusal is absence) — the gate becomes topology, not decoration.
